incident.summary: A retryable native-stage-timeout coding failure whose saved route then failed launch validation stayed coding/active for ~2.5h: the recovery controller waited on an execution-contract-available wake nothing produced, and the task-recovery job exited ok every pass.
incident.operatorAction: A refused saved route must escalate once through failure-policy and escalate_operator_attention, naming the stage, model and validator reason; reroute the stage to clear it.

evidence.redactedData: phase=coding status=active; coding stage failed retryable native-stage-timeout at 13:11; recovery job exited {ok:true,exitCode:0}.
No relaunch, retry counter, hook change or inbox item after ~2.5h; operator found it by hand.

failure.detail: native-stage-timeout: native coding exhausted its model time budget

contract.detail: Recovery contract for model kimi-k2.7-code is unavailable: current resolver supports agent native-openrouter, not persisted agent claude. Run wavemill reroute <task-id> --phase <planning|coding|review> to choose an audited replacement.
